name: AI Builder – Generate pages, blocks, images & translate with AI
author: Enki

sections.description:
Transform your WordPress workflow with the ultimate AI Copilot. AI Builder is not just another template shuffler. It is a native AI Page Builder that generates 100% custom Gutenberg pages, blocks, and content tailored to your specific prompts.

Whether you need a high-converting landing page, a complex “Features” section, or a full blog post with images, AI Builder creates it in seconds—right inside the editor.

🚀 Start for FREE: Get 150 credits immediately upon signup (No credit card required).

🔍 Why Choose AI Builder?

Most AI tools force you to use their proprietary builders. AI Builder works natively with Gutenberg. This means zero bloat, perfect performance, and you own the code forever.

What you can achieve in minutes:

  • ⚡ Instant Page Building: Generate complete Homepages, About Us, or Pricing pages from a simple description.
  • 🪄 Modify Existing Blocks with AI: Select any block in the editor and refine it using natural language (layout tweaks, new elements, copy improvements, styling changes) without rebuilding the whole section.
  • 🎨 Custom Design & CSS: The AI doesn’t just insert text; it styles your blocks with custom CSS to match your brand identity.
  • 🧩 Smart Block Creation: Need a specific “Pros & Cons” table or a “Team Member” slider? Just ask, and the AI builds the block structure for you.
  • 🎭 Pre‑Configured Design Prompts: Choose from curated visual styles (design prompts) to quickly generate pages with a consistent, high-quality look and feel.
  • ✍️ Context-Aware Copywriting: Write SEO-optimized headings, paragraphs, and CTAs that actually sound like your brand.
  • 🖼️ Integrated AI Images: Generate royalty-free, unique images directly inside your image blocks. No more searching for stock photos.
  • 📱 Performance First: All generated images are automatically compressed for the web.
  • 🌍 Go Global Instantly: Translate entire pages, headers, and footers in one click. The AI handles the content translation and automatically links pages together with a built-in language switcher.

“Perfect for freelancers, agencies, and site owners who want to scaffold websites in hours, not days.”

Don’t want to use Gutenberg? Check out the Pagora AI plugin: it builds your whole website with AI and comes with its own built-in editor. Every page is 100% custom-made, with a visual editor and full access to the code.

Key Features

  • 🧠 AI Page Generator – Turn a single sentence into a fully designed landing page (Header, Content, Footer).
  • 📦 Gutenberg Native – Creates standard blocks that are lightweight and fully editable.
  • 🎨 Smart Styling System – Generates custom CSS for every element based on your prompt.
  • 🪄 AI Block Modifier – Select an existing block and ask AI to improve, extend, or restyle it while keeping your page intact.
  • 🎭 Curated Visual Styles – Use pre-configured design prompts to generate pages with consistent aesthetics (e.g. neobrutalism, premium dark, minimalist, editorial).
  • 🖼️ Text-to-Image Engine – Generate and insert relevant images without leaving WordPress.
  • ✍️ Content Copilot – Expand, rewrite, or translate text directly within any paragraph block.
  • ⚙️ Brand Awareness – Define your site colors and business info in settings; the AI applies them to every generation.
  • 🚀 Multi-Page Generator – Create up to 10 pages simultaneously to build a full site structure in one click.
  • 🌐 AI Translation Engine – Clone and translate full pages with context-aware AI. Automatically adds a frontend language switcher and manages navigation routing between languages.
  • 🛒 WooCommerce Integration – Fully compatible with WooCommerce. The AI automatically detects WooCommerce and includes product blocks when creating e-commerce pages.

External services

Sentry (error reporting)

When an AI generation fails in the WordPress admin (AI chat in the editor, multi-page generator, AI Block), AI Builder sends a short error report to Sentry (sentry.io) so the failure can be diagnosed and fixed. Nothing is sent when generations succeed, and failures that only reflect your account state (not signed in, no credits left, too many requests, expired session, lost connection) are not reported.

A report contains: the error code, the action and AI Builder endpoint involved, the HTTP status and error message returned by the AI service, the request duration, the JavaScript stack trace, the AI Builder and WordPress versions, the URL of the admin page where the error happened, and your browser’s user agent. It never contains your prompt, your page content, your name or your email address.

Reporting can be turned off by adding define( 'AIBUI_SENTRY_DSN', '' ); to wp-config.php, or with the aibui_sentry_dsn filter.

Sentry terms of service: https://sentry.io/terms/
Sentry privacy policy: https://sentry.io/privacy/

Credits

Developed by enkicorbin

Support

For support, documentation, and feature requests, please visit our website: https://website-ai-builder.com
Thank you for choosing WordPress AI Builder!
sections.installation:
1. Install AI Builder via the WordPress.org plugin directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Create an account
  4. Start using the AI tools in your Gutenberg editor
sections.faq:
Is the plugin free to try?

Yes! You get 150 free credits immediately upon signup to test all features (page generation, text, images). No credit card or OpenAI API key is required.

What happens to my content if I cancel my subscription?

You keep 100% of your content. Unlike other builders, AI Builder generates standard WordPress Gutenberg blocks and CSS that are saved directly to your database. If you cancel your subscription, your pages will look exactly the same and remain fully editable.

Do I need my own OpenAI API Key?

No. We handle all the AI processing on our secure servers. You don’t need to pay for ChatGPT or OpenAI separately; everything is included in your credits.

Does it work with my Theme (Astra, Kadence, OceanWP, etc.)?

Yes. AI Builder generates native blocks that inherit your theme’s global settings (fonts, widths, etc.). It is designed to work seamlessly with any well-coded WordPress theme.

Can I edit the content after it’s generated?

Absolutely. The AI creates standard blocks (Headings, Paragraphs, Images, Columns). You can click and edit them just like any other content in WordPress.

Are the generated images optimized for the web?

Yes. Images generated by the AI are automatically compressed and converted to web-friendly formats to ensure your site loads fast, without sacrificing quality.

Can I use this with page builders like Elementor or Divi?

AI Builder is designed for the native Gutenberg Editor to ensure maximum performance and PageSpeed scores. However, you can use it alongside other builders if you use Gutenberg for your blog posts or specific landing pages.

How do the credits work?

Each action (generating a page, a block, or an image) costs a certain amount of credits. You can view your balance directly in the plugin interface. We offer flexible subscriptions and one-time credit packs if you need more.

Can I make my website multilingual with AI Builder?

Yes. You can translate any page, header, or footer into another language with a single click. The AI doesn’t just translate word-for-word; it adapts the context. The plugin automatically adds a language switcher to your site and handles the routing, so users are seamlessly redirected to the correct page in their language.

Do I need a separate plugin like WPML or Polylang?

For most standard websites, no. AI Builder’s built-in translation features handle page duplication, content translation, and menu linking automatically. It’s a lightweight alternative designed to get your multilingual site running in minutes without complex configuration.

Is AI Builder compatible with WooCommerce?

Yes! AI Builder is fully compatible with WooCommerce. When WooCommerce is installed, the AI automatically detects it and will include WooCommerce-specific blocks (product cards, add to cart buttons, product galleries, etc.) when you ask it to create a product page or any e-commerce related content.
sections.changelog:
2.9.0

The AI chat now lives in the editor toolbar, with a style picker and a credit estimate before each request. New Sections page: save any block as a reusable section, and the AI reuses your sections instead of generating them again. New Page ideas page: SEO page suggestions tailored to your site, generated in one click. Headers and footers of your theme can now be translated, without duplicating them. Generations now follow your theme styles and patterns. New subscription management in Account and Credits. Redesigned admin pages and tutorial.

2.7.9

Clearer error reporting in the AI chat: instead of one generic sentence, failures now explain what happened (connection timeout, request blocked by a firewall, expired WordPress session, blocks unavailable on this site…) and include a short support code. A generation containing a block your site does not have is no longer discarded: the other blocks are inserted and the missing ones are listed. Fixed “Generate block” showing a generic error instead of the dedicated message when credits ran out.

2.7.8

Security: saving custom JavaScript for a page, block or Site Editor template now requires the unfiltered_html capability (previously edit_post), and the JS post meta can no longer be written through the Custom Fields box or XML-RPC. Fixes a stored XSS reachable by Contributor accounts in versions 2.4.1 to 2.7.7. Reported by md. minaruzzaman shovon via WPScan.

2.1.2

Compatibility update for WordPress 6.7+ and improved CSS generation for complex blocks.

2.1.1

Fixed a minor issue with the queue system in the Multi-Page Generator.

2.1.0

New Feature: Multi-Page Generator! You can now generate multiple pages (Home, About, Contact) in a single prompt.

2.0.2

Fixed an issue where saved brand colors were not correctly applied to generated buttons.

2.0.1

Major Update: Added “Settings” panel to define your Brand Identity (Colors, Business Name) for consistent AI results.

1.1.4

Improved compatibility with popular themes (Astra, OceanWP) and minor UI fixes in the chat interface.

1.1.3

Security improvements and optimization of the credit consumption logic.

1.1.2

Fixed a minor issue

1.1.1

Hotfix: Resolved a character encoding issue in AI-generated headings.

1.1.0

Fixed a minor issue

1.0.4

Optimization: Faster response time for image generation requests.

1.0.3

Improved the prompt understanding for “Contact Form” and “Pricing Table” blocks.

1.0.2

Fixed a CSS conflict that prevented the chat widget from opening on mobile devices.

1.0.1

Minor bug fixes and stability improvements for the initial connection to AI servers.

1.0.0

Initial release of WordPress AI Builder – build websites faster with the power of AI.
